# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos, beyond division, is revealed here through disciplined division of work: many inspections, one purpose. Awtsmoos.com will be improved where the vessel is cracked, not repainted where it already carries light well.

## Phase A — Repository revelation

- Map top-level project structure and package scripts.
- Discover route/page/app/game entry points.
- Discover shared layout, navigation, overlay, and style primitives.
- Map test and preview mechanisms.
- Record source files that carry unusually high UI fan-out.

## Phase B — Structural UI risk scan

Search human-authored UI source for:

- `z-index`, fixed/sticky positioning, stacking-context creators.
- hard viewport widths/min-widths, 100vh, overflow clipping.
- mobile breakpoints and missing responsive handling.
- canvas/HUD geometry and fixed game controls.
- modal/popover/dialog sizing and scrolling.
- dense nav/toolbars and touch target risks.
- global CSS rules with wide blast radius.

Each candidate becomes either: proven issue, needs runtime check, or harmless/intentional.

## Phase C — Runtime verification

- Start or locate the project’s normal development/runtime path without installing dependencies.
- Use browser controls against representative routes from every route family.
- Inspect desktop and mobile viewport states.
- Check horizontal overflow, fixed overlays, open dialogs/menus, game HUD collisions, and console errors.
- Capture evidence for defects before mutation.

## Phase D — Implementation

For each proven defect:

- Trace owning file and consumers.
- Read full file plus connected callers/styles.
- Rewrite complete touched files only.
- Preserve existing contracts and page identity.
- Split oversized touched source into coherent modules if necessary.
- Use tabs, readable multiline code, strong documentation, and project conventions.
- Avoid dependencies and global hacks unless the defect is genuinely global.

## Phase E — Verification

- Re-read all touched files.
- Run syntax/lint/build/tests available in the repository.
- Re-run browser checks at affected desktop/mobile widths.
- Inspect console and document overflow.
- Review git diff and affected routes/components.
- Compare planned vs actual and resolve delta.

## Remaining-work ledger

Initial state:

- [ ] Route/app/game inventory complete.
- [ ] Shared UI primitive map complete.
- [ ] Structural UI risk scan complete.
- [ ] Runtime representative sweep complete.
- [ ] Proven defects implemented.
- [ ] Modified files re-read.
- [ ] Build/syntax/tests pass for affected scope.
- [ ] Browser regression sweep passes.
- [ ] Git diff contains no unrelated changes.
- [ ] Final completion gate has no evidence-backed remaining UI/UX defect in requested scope.
